recoverable_cases: verified journal is exactly one complete event ahead of an anchored checkpoint, with projection matching the prior or tail state
incomplete invalid JSON tail is present while head and projection anchor the exact complete verified prefix
bootstrap marker is valid and incomplete initialization artifacts are consistent with the zero-sequence baseline
mandatory_assertions: all complete journal records verify schema, sequence, event identity and hash chain before repair
no event ID appears more than once
each completed target event survives exactly one replay after restart
partial invalid frame bytes are preserved by SHA-256 before truncation
a recovery receipt is bound to exact observed evidence and represented once in the canonical journal
ambiguous complete JSON without delimiter is not discarded or accepted
missing/corrupt/unanchored head, corrupted journal, non-matching projection or checkpoint lag greater than one event fail closed without guessed repair
a second restart after recovery preserves the same event inventory and verified head
after a write-boundary error, the same StateStore instance rejects all later emits until a fresh validated reopen
negative_controls: complete JSON frame missing final newline
journal chain tamper, sequence gap, duplicate event ID
side_effect_scope: all fault injection uses per-test TemporaryDirectory and child subprocesses; no production state path is opened
verdict_rule: PASS for tested recoverable injection windows only; unresolved/ambiguous corruption remains an explicitly blocking fail-closed status
